starting_state: base, zero LoRA B, paired initialized A; no task warmup

target_generation.selection: first normally terminated candidate with complete boxed answer verified against gold; same rule both sources

training_set: intersection of verified student and teacher candidate question IDs; raw references restricted to exactly that intersection
selection: per-arm dev correct count descending, then fewer steps, then lower LR; same grid per arm; final test not used for selection
replication: fixed selected LR/step per arm, fresh initialization and order for seeds102/103; generation targets and split held fixed
uncertainty: paired questions plus three fitted seeds, not repeated target generation/splits
historical_training_and_dev_reuse: GSM8K official train/test have been used by prior studies; current question partition freshly fixed, not a fresh unseen benchmark
budget_scope: record generation, optimization, evaluation and search separately; equal sample exposures do not match target tokens
environment_incident: shell sandbox failed between initial goal creation and restoration around08:15UTC; no earlier compute launched
budget_restart: User explicitly restarted five hours after execution restored
matched_target_control: Also evaluate all arms at the LR/stopping point selected by the reference-only dev search, for every training seed. Report this separately from per-arm independently tuned recipes.
